violations.text: Thermometer is lacking in the 1-door reach-in refrigeration unit. All cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer inside the unit that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2026

The dishwasher is a residential model and is not currently reaching the required rinse temperature of 180 degrees F. 3-bay sink is to be used to sanitize until dishwasher is adjusted (per manufacturer's instruction) and can reach proper sanitizing temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the dishwasher. Test strips have been ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2026

The ice machine is lacking a proper air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2026
